For a thin lens, transverse magnification is \(m\), longitudinal magnification is \(m^2\), so volume magnification is \(m^4\).  
For the final image to remain a cuboid, the two-lens system must be afocal, so  
\[
f_1+f_2=10\text{ cm},\qquad \left|\frac{f_2}{f_1}\right|=500^{1/4}=q.
\]
Thus
\[
f_1=\frac{10}{1+q},\qquad q=500^{1/4}\approx 4.728708.
\]
The left-lens transverse magnification for the object face at \(2\text{ cm}\) is
\[
|m_1|=\frac{f_1}{2-f_1}
=\frac{5}{q-4}\approx 6.86146.
\]
So the maximum intermediate volume is
\[
|m_1|^4 \cdot 1\text{ cm}^3
\approx 2216.49\text{ cm}^3.
\]

ANSWER: 2216.49
